candidates.title: How to PROPERLY Use The Adductor Machine (STOP THIS)
candidates.description:
Drop some 🔥🔥 below if you found this helpful.

The adductor machine is an amazing exercise, but often done improperly.

2 things to avoid:
❌ Poor range of motion
❌ Clang and bang (letting the weight stack hit)

Instead:
✅ Adjust the pad to go out as far as possible
✅ Bring your legs in and out, nice and controlled
✅ Make sure you’re feeling through stretch in your groin area with each rep

Give it a shot and let me know how it goes. 🔥

P.s, full YouTube video explaining this exercise was just uploaded to YouTube.

Just search “Colossus Fitness” and you’ll be able to find it. 🙌

candidates.title: Hip Abduction Machine (KNOW THE DIFFERENCE!)
candidates.description:
If you sit with your body upright, you'll work the upper and lower glutes.   If you lean forward, you'll shift the focus to the lower glutes (glute maximus).  If you lean back, you'll shift the emphasis to the upper glutes (glute medius and upper glute maximus).

candidates.title: Seated Hip Adduction Machine Tutorial
candidates.description:
SEATED HIP ADDUCTION MACHINE TUTORIAL! If you are new to the gym & don’t know where to start, give me a follow & stay tuned! I am going to be posting a ton of educational content to help you become comfortable & get started in the gym! 😊

✨Seated Hip Adduction Machine Tips:✨
-Adjust range of motion with the lever on the side
-The further the leg pads are apart = greater range of motion
-If you can’t adjust the back of the seat on your machine, its okay to lean forward a little for a better feel as long as your core is engaged & your spine is neutral
-Maintain good control & avoid using momentum as you open & close your legs
